verdict.rationale: Lorikeet lets users build and deploy workflows in natural language (including via MCP) that the AI agent then runs autonomously to resolve customer issues end-to-end across channels. Outbound campaigns run on scheduled cadences, and Coach reviews 100% of tickets and can implement improvements on the user's behalf, which together amount to background automation. missing for 10: generic scheduled/event-triggered automations beyond customer-support workflows and outbound campaigns, detail on how background runs are monitored or configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor claims).
